asset_label: electrical equipment (switchboard, panelboard, breaker, lug or conductor) seen in a thermal image or described by thermal and load readings
source_note: The ANSI/NETA MTS-2023 delta-T severity table (https://www.netaworld.org/standards/ansi-neta-mts) was NOT retrieved, so every delta-T band below is [team-proposed, validate] (DT_BANDS_K). The load rows are [Assumption] on NEC 210.20(A) 125 percent continuous-load sizing and the NEC Article 100 'continuous load' of 3 hours; the NEC text was not read this session. The annual IR row cites a vendor secondary source (https://www.fluke.com/en-us/learn/blog/thermal-imaging/nfpa-70b-how-thermal-imaging-supports-electrical-equipment-maintenance) for NFPA 70B 2023; the primary was not read. Readings are graded deterministically by cascade.building.electrical: each row carries a 'family', 'min' (inclusive) and 'max' (exclusive). The unified mapping is the team's own [team-proposed, validate].

rows.criterion: Temperature rise over a similar component under similar load below 1 K (DT_BANDS_K [team-proposed, validate]).
rows.source: DT_BANDS_K [team-proposed, validate]; validate against ANSI/NETA MTS-2023 https://www.netaworld.org/standards/ansi-neta-mts

rows.criterion: Temperature rise over a similar component under similar load of 1 to 4 K (DT_BANDS_K [team-proposed, validate]).
rows.source: DT_BANDS_K [team-proposed, validate]; validate against ANSI/NETA MTS-2023 https://www.netaworld.org/standards/ansi-neta-mts

rows.criterion: Temperature rise over a similar component under similar load of 4 to 15 K (DT_BANDS_K [team-proposed, validate]).
rows.source: DT_BANDS_K [team-proposed, validate]; validate against ANSI/NETA MTS-2023 https://www.netaworld.org/standards/ansi-neta-mts

rows.criterion: Temperature rise over a similar component under similar load of 15 K or more (DT_BANDS_K [team-proposed, validate]).
rows.source: DT_BANDS_K [team-proposed, validate]; validate against ANSI/NETA MTS-2023 https://www.netaworld.org/standards/ansi-neta-mts

rows.criterion: Highest 3-hour mean load below 80 percent of the breaker rating (LOAD_CONT_PCT [Assumption]).
Load of 80 to 100 percent of the breaker rating held for 3 hours or more (LOAD_CONT_PCT, CONTINUOUS_H [Assumption]).
rows.source: LOAD_CONT_PCT, CONTINUOUS_H [Assumption] NEC 210.20(A) and Article 100, text not read

rows.criterion: Load of 100 percent of the breaker rating or more held for 3 hours or more [Assumption].
No infrared scan of this equipment for 365 days or more (IR_INTERVAL_DAYS [PUBLIC, secondary]).
No reference temperature, load at scan below IR_MIN_LOAD_PCT, or no rating in the panel schedule: U, never Band 0 or Load ok.
rows.source: project rule (U is never S0); IR_MIN_LOAD_PCT [team-proposed, validate]

unified_note: Band 3 with visible discoloration or arcing marks, or water on or above the equipment, maps to S4 (escalate) [team-proposed, validate].
measurement_note: delta_t_k = t_element_c - t_reference_c, where the reference is a similar component under similar load. A thermal image alone gives no delta-T: the grader needs both temperatures and the load at scan time in the metadata, otherwise U.

flags.not_measurable: set when a reference temperature, a load reading or a rating is missing
flags.fire_shock_pathway: set by the problem manager when water reaches this equipment
